components.name: bwell-wallet
components.description: A patient health app for sharing essential data with providers.
components.testPatient: Allison Hackett (synthetic, born 1984-03-17): problems, allergies, medications, immunizations, and a US Core insurance card. No sign-in — the wallet opens straight to the consent screen.
components.notes: Self-serve, no sign-in. Holds fabricated records for one synthetic patient. Supports the three minimum scenarios: share records and insurance, a form inline, and declining an item. Inline FHIR Questionnaires render with group nesting, enableWhen, required questions and prefilled initial values; a form named only by canonical URL is reported unsupported. Items the wallet holds nothing for come back unavailable. Responses run about 17 KB.
